messages:
Mira: quick sync — framing vs server-coalesce for raven-liteq int4 streaming fragcases.
Arjun: test matrix?
Mira: int4/int8, temps 0/0.3/0.7, stream vs non-stream, batch 1/4, 1.2k prompts incl ~300 long-arg stress cases.
Javi: running schema-coverage v0.4 to collect parse_failure_class + chunk-hashes + trailing-comma hits.
bench-bot: job 1839990000-A started on canary-gpu
Mira: baseline numbers: int8 stream parse_success 97.4%, int4 stream 79.0%, int4 non-stream ~89.1%.
Tess: that's a big streaming delta. server coalesce helped before — what did framing look like in lab?
Mira: quick lab runs: coalesce (32B lookahead) -> int4 stream 91.5% (p95 latency +130ms). framing (len-prefixed netstring-like) -> 96.8% with p95 +15ms but requires SDK bump.
Arjun: framing proposal: netstring-style prefix so clients can reassemble partial chunks without server buffering. example chunk: 
```
54:{"tool_call":{"name":"note","args":"{\"body\":\"partial chunk...\"}"}}
```
Javi: we also prototyped a 4-byte u32 BE header for binary transports; that eliminated ambiguity entirely but needs transport support for browsers.
Mira: ops note: framing dramatically reduced per-worker buffer pressure in the prototype (no server-side hold), so fewer OOMs. coalesce still useful as an immediate opt-in.
Tess: product preference: opt-in coalesce for enterprise/dedicated as short-term, framing as recommended long-term path. can we ship SDK with framing support quickly?
Arjun: yes — target: SDK v0.10 beta in ~2 weeks. we'll include both parsing helpers and a rolling compatibility mode (server will accept framed and unframed chunks during transition).
Javi: infra: we'll run an A/B canary comparing coalesce vs framing vs baseline. metrics: parse_success, p50/p95 latency, retry_budget use, and 5xxs.
bench-bot: job 1839990000-B queued for 23:00 PT (A/B canary)
Mira: additional findings from int4: a small non-stream class with trailing commas / extra-escape sequences (~0.25%) — filed RW-7122 for model cleanup and scheduled an int4 kernel-pad calibration experiment.
Lin: ops action: add per-worker buffer cap logging and an alert on buffer growth during coalesce warmup.
Mira: action items: 1) RFC for framing format + SDK changes (Arjun), 2) feature-flagged coalesce opt-in by tier (Mira), 3) nightly A/B canary (bench-bot), 4) expand long-arg stress set and re-run calibration (Javi).
Tess: rollouts: enable coalesce for internal enterprise canaries this week, SDK beta in 2w, general guidance in Console docs.
bench-bot: job 1839990480 completed; artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-canary/1839990000/artifacts (coverage + ab-results)
Tess: thanks — will review artifacts in tomorrow's triage. :white_check_mark:
file_notes: framing vs coalesce triage for int4 streaming fragcases
